# The Yatra Company

> Taxi and intercity cab service based in Chinhat, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, India. Offers airport transfers, local city taxi, outstation/intercity trips, corporate travel, wedding transportation, and religious tour cabs across Uttar Pradesh. Booking via phone call or WhatsApp. Rated 4.9/5 on Google (9 reviews).

## Core Info

- Service area: Lucknow and Uttar Pradesh (Delhi, Varanasi, Kanpur, Ayodhya, Gorakhpur, Prayagraj routes serviced)
- Address: T9-1103, Sun Breeze 1, Faizabad Road, BBD Green City, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh 226028, India
- Phone / WhatsApp booking: +91-91988 93198
- Email: theyatracompanyofficial@gmail.com
- Hours: Open 24x7, every day
- Vehicle types: Sedan, SUV, Innova Hycross
- Booking method: Phone call or WhatsApp message with pickup/drop location, date, and car type — no online payment or app required

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://theyatracompany.com/services): Full list of offerings — airport transfer, local rental, outstation trip, corporate travel, wedding transportation, religious tours.

- [Lucknow to Kanpur Taxi](https://theyatracompany.com/travel-guides/lucknow-to-kanpur-taxi): Same-day business and regional cab.
- [Lucknow to Ayodhya Taxi](https://theyatracompany.com/travel-guides/lucknow-to-ayodhya-taxi): Pilgrimage route cab service.
- [Lucknow to Gorakhpur Taxi](https://theyatracompany.com/travel-guides/lucknow-to-gorakhpur-taxi): Intercity outstation cab.
- [Lucknow to Prayagraj Taxi](https://theyatracompany.com/travel-guides/lucknow-to-prayagraj-taxi): Intercity outstation cab.
- [Gomti Nagar Corporate Taxi](https://theyatracompany.com/travel-guides/gomti-nagar-corporate-taxi): Local corporate travel in Gomti Nagar, Lucknow.
- [Hazratganj Taxi Service](https://theyatracompany.com/travel-guides/hazratganj-taxi-service): Local taxi service in Hazratganj, Lucknow.
